Space Marine.... as long time fan of Warhammer 40.000 universum ( and tabletop wargame ) I was curious about this game a lot. It was a bit of let down. First impressions are great, Astartes feels bulky and heavy, atmosphere is breathing 40k greatly but it kinda vanish after couple of levels and then there are problems. This game is very repetitive. You really do just 1 thing all the time. Levels are plain and bit boring by design. Essentialy you are either inside where there is not much difference between different buildings or you are outside which is only differently textured hallway...no big open spaces.
Also if you are fan of 40k and know something about Space Marines you´ll get dissapointed some more. Bolter feels good, sound is great, overall awesome but performance in actuall killing is underwhelming. Ork boy wearing a t-shirt  easily takes  4-5 rounds to body which is in fluff enough to put down a space marine in power armour. Another thing which felt a bit wrong was that you play as Ultramarine, a chapter known best for their tactical aproach to things and here it´s really just bloodbath more suited for say Space Wolves or World Eaters... it just doesn´t feel like Ultramarine.
So if you are not a fan of 40k or you don´t know about it a bit there is slightly above average 3rd person shooter/slasher for you. You´re gonna play it, finish it but you won´t probably remember it. 6/10
If you are fan of 40k you´re gonna joy puke at the beginning (especially if you are imperial fan, as I am chaos player in tabletop) but you are gonna be sorely dissapointed by the end of it if you even make it there. 5/10

I highly recommend this game despite some of it's flaws. The melee combat in this game is just incredible (as you can see in my screenshots), but on the other hand, the shooting is nothing special. There are a variety of weapons you have, both melee and ranged, which is a positive, and I'm no Warhammer 40k person, but I believe they are proper weapons from the series. The visuals and performance of this game is pretty good too, considering the computer I played it on is pushing five years old and was nothing special at the time anyway. The story, whilst not amazing, is fairly decent and enjoyable. The fact that I know next to nothing about Warhammer yet I enjoyed the game says a lot too!

On top of the ranged combat being not so amazing the game did get a bit bland at times. Often you are running through large open corriders opening doors along the way without seeing any enemies for what seems like forever. Gladly, though, when killing Orks starts to get boring, without spoiling anything for you, you are introduced to some new enemies, making for a progessive game. Having said that, though, the main difference between the Orks and these new enemies is (obviously their appearance, but) their strength and health. They play very similarly to the Orks but, seeing as though you get better armour and weapons as you go, it all just feels a bit repetitive.

But, like I said, I still enjoyed this game. It's a lot of fun even for people who have never even heard of Warhammer before. It's a tad on the short side and I didn't check out the Multiplayer for this game but I'd imagine it's a bit empty nowadays (you might want to check that though). I would say definitely get it when it's on sale, because it really is a great third person shooter. Enjoy! :D
